intro.label: Hair Restoration
intro.title: Are you concerned about hair loss and how it affects your personal image?
items: Every time you look in the mirror, you notice less density, more marked receding hairlines, or areas where hair no longer looks the same.
Perhaps you've tried products, shampoos, supplements, or treatments without obtaining the results you expected.
The reality is that hair loss can impact much more than physical appearance. It can affect confidence, personal security, and even how you relate to others.
But there is an alternative designed for those who wish to improve their hair appearance in a progressive, natural, and personalized way.

box.title: Discover Hair Transplant at MJ Estética & Wellness Center
box.p1: At MJ Estética & Wellness Center, we understand that every person has a different story behind their hair loss. That's why we develop personalized protocols aimed at restoring hair appearance while respecting facial harmony and seeking progressive and natural results.
box.p2: Our approach consists not only of recovering hair. We seek to help you regain confidence, security, and aesthetic well-being.

timeline.title: When do you start noticing results?
timeline.p1: This is one of the most frequently asked questions. The answer is simple: Results are progressive.
timeline.p2: Each patient evolves differently and times can vary based on multiple individual factors.
timeline.p3: The important thing is to understand that hair growth requires time and follow-up. Evolution is usually observed gradually as the recovery process advances.
